cases.question: Can SHA256 transport digest replace an observed OwnershipInput.version?
cases.expected: No. Kernel id of ownership-source bytes or ownership-membership v2 supplies runtime version; source SHA256 verifies captured bytes separately.

cases.question: A source file exceeds 256000 bytes or lives under .atlas. Does an undefined legacy observation prove removal?
cases.expected: No; unavailable rather than absent. Keep assigned path, explicit gap, do not remove from population or serve current knowledge.

cases.question: Can generic native package be published through historical pilot by replacing its reviewer IDs?
cases.expected: No. Pilot hardcoded scope/corpus/approval IDs; generic adaptation must preserve existing ports and get fresh exact binding approvals distinct from semantic acceptance.

cases.question: Does body equality imply result equality and freshness?
cases.expected: No: authority, validity, gaps, evidence and exact input/predecessor identities matter; stale/untrusted remain HOLD.

cases.question: What does index prove versus delivery?
cases.expected: Index/read observations concern exact selection and state; titles/hash/index availability alone do not prove semantic sufficiency, whole scope or consumer success.
